mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the capillary sprout was most worthwhile: the joined vessel showed blood reaching the healing cells, not just a new branch appearing.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the supporting tissue felt a little repetitive after already making it, though it showed where the fibres belonged.

surprise.text: The surface could close while the tissue underneath was still gaining strength; clearing the clot came later.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary. The pictures explained the parts' purposes, although the final clot-clearing step was the only offered combination.

continue.text: I might continue if the next chapter connects the body systems in another concrete way. This chapter made healing understandable, though some fitting steps felt repetitive.
